script.cover_1: A junior leaves at 6 pm and hears a joke.
script.cover_2: Find out what the joke costs.
script.payoff: It teaches the junior to stay late just to be seen.
script.caption: A joke about leaving on time is still a rule about staying late. Send this to the manager who makes it often.
script.lands: The junior may start staying late to be seen, even when the work is done.
script.better: Anything pending before you go? If not, good evening.
script.why: It checks the work, not the clock, and lets the junior leave with ease.
